objectives.title: Demonstrate current mathematical baseline
objectives.summary: Identify current strengths and gaps across selected foundational mathematics topics.
objectives.target_object: selected number, fraction, ratio, algebra and graph-reading tasks
conditions: Complete independently under recorded diagnostic conditions.
Mark confidence separately for selected answers.
success_criteria: Selected methods are explained clearly enough to identify misconceptions.
Confidence is recorded separately from correctness.
misconceptions: A single diagnostic score represents complete mathematical ability.
objectives.review_notes: Draft diagnostic objective; it routes learning and is not a gate or mastery claim.
